interval_years.quote: The department shall provide, by rule, a method for biennial license renewal at fees set forth in s. 478.55.

required.quote: An application for license renewal must be accompanied by proof of the successful completion of 20 hours of continuing education courses or proof of successfully passing a reexamination for licensure within the immediately preceding biennium

available.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to any applicant who, upon submitting an application and the required fees as set forth in s. 478.55, demonstrates to the board that he or she meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145.

requirements.value: Applicant must meet the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145 (MOBILE Act), which includes holding an active unencumbered license from another state in a profession with a similar scope of practice, having practiced for at least 2 years in the 4-year period before application, and passing a national licensure examination or holding a national certification recognized by the board.
requirements.quote: demonstrates to the board that he or she meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

authority.quote: The board, with the assistance of the Electrolysis Council, is authorized to establish minimum standards for the delivery of electrolysis services and to adopt rules pursuant to ss. 120.536(1) and 120.54 to implement the provisions of this chapter.
